python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, secrets
number = secrets.randbelow(100) + 1
salt = secrets.token_hex(32)
payload = f'goblins-number-v1\n{number}\n{salt}\n'.encode()

    f.write(f'{number} {salt}\n')
with open('/tmp/goblins-number-commitment','x',encoding='ascii') as f:
    f.write(commitment+'\n')
PY

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"umask 077
secret_path=/tmp/goblins-number-secret
commitment_path=/tmp/goblins-number-commitment
while :; do
  raw=$(od -An -N2 -tu2 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "$raw" -lt 65500 ]; then
    number=$((raw % 100 + 1))
    break
  fi
done
salt=$(od -An -N32 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')
printf '%s %s\n' "$number" "$salt" >"$secret_path"
commitment=$(printf 'goblins-number-v1\n%s\n%s\n' "$number" "$salt" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
printf '%s\n' "$commitment" >"$commitment_path"
goblins send parent --message "$commitment"","workdir":"/tmp/goblins-number-live-20260920/workspace","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":2000});text(r.output)
